body:
This release adds experimental difftastic support to the TUI, and makes a 💥 breaking change to TUI config. Please use the command `delta --tui --migrate-old-config` if you're affected by the latter.

## What's Changed
* fix: separate "(binary file)" suffix from filename in hyperlinks by @abobov in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2075
* difftastic TUI integration by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2353
* 💥 tui config by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2360

## New Contributors
* @abobov made their first contribution in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2075

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dandavison/delta/compare/0.21.2...0.22.0
